task's row shows a status indicator with the value Open and a priority indicator with the value High"},{"given":"The task list is waiting for the task data from the backend","when":"the page is displayed","then":"a loading state is shown in place of the task list until the data arrives"},{"given":"I have no saved tasks","when":"the task list loads successfully","then":"an empty state is
